items.title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
items.desc: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH transfers over two days as the Binance hackers moved the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to obscure their trail.

items.desc_vi: OnChain Lens đã theo dõi gần 600 triệu đô la chuyển khoản ETH trong hai ngày khi tin tặc Binance chuyển số tiền bị đánh cắp qua ví mới và giao thức chuỗi chéo để che giấu dấu vết của chúng.

rw.title: Binance hack: Nearly $600M in ETH shuffled via THORChain and Chainflip
rw.summary: Over two days, Binance hackers moved almost $600 million of stolen ETH through new wallets and cross‑chain protocols, obscuring the trail.
rw.note: The use of THORChain and Chainflip highlights the growing role of decentralized bridges in laundering stolen cryptocurrency.
